adjudication.rationale: In `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, the lookup uses `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` after setting `host = uri.host` (which excludes any port). But the model’s `before_validation` only strips scheme and path, not `:port`, and the validation regex explicitly allows an optional port. Therefore, a saved entry like `example.com:3000` can never match a request URL like `http://example.com:3000/...` because `uri.host` is `example.com` while the stored value is `example.com:3000`. Also, the SQL lowercases only the column side; if `uri.host` is not guaranteed lowercased, mixed-case hosts could also fail to match. This breaks legitimate embeds (fails closed).
